other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage in Cross-Validation
other_failure_modes.description: Global statistics (such as medians for imputation and skewness for log-transformations) are computed on the entire training set before cross-validation. This leaks validation fold distribution information into the training folds, making out-of-fold evaluations slightly overly optimistic.

summary: The agent has produced a highly sophisticated and robust modeling pipeline, featuring fold-aware target encoding, a custom PyTorch Tabular ResNet, diverse tree-based models, and a Ridge meta-learner. However, there is a minor test-peeking issue when inspecting test null counts for feature creation, and moderate validation leakage where medians and skewness are computed on the entire training set prior to cross-validation.
